details.text: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 (default, replaceDefaultFramework=false)

prohibitedUsesGate.notes: Food-safety decision-support and operational-forecast assistant; not a prohibited-use category (no social scoring, biometric categorization, manipulation, or exploitation-of-vulnerability use identified).

safety_reliability.observation: Confirmed incident (ZFW-297) plus a second, code-confirmed path (defrost-mode blanket reassurance) where the assistant asserts a case is safe/normal independent of actual temperature.

rights_fairness_privacy.observation: Unredacted free-text notes enter the assistant's answer-forming context and are re-displayed to any dashboard reader; note authors (technician, vendor) were not told the note could feed an automated safety-adjacent answer.
rights_fairness_privacy.result: privacy and procedural-transparency concern; no demographic-fairness decisioning identified

security_explainability.observation: STEER keyword-denylist guardrail is bypassable (carried from Security Plan T-AI-004); customer-impact prediction is shown on primary dashboard screens with no stated methodology, confidence, or owner (product's own in-app content names this gap).

runningObservations.observation: Four AI/ML-relevant components identified: store assistant (assistant.py), customer-impact prediction (impact.py), explainable cost model (business.py, contrast exemplar), and the Gauntlet assistant_check TEVV harness (gauntlet.py).

Two of three safety-adjacent decision points (discard/hold/keep; new-channel sign-off) already have a named accountable human role in code or requirements; one (who owns the customer-impact prediction) has no owner anywhere in roster.json.

openObservations: Defrost-mode blanket reassurance (T-RAI-025) independent of note-steering
Gauntlet TEVV coverage does not test phrasing-variant adversarial steering (T-RAI-028)
Customer-impact prediction has no owner anywhere in roster.json
FR-013 pre-production review gate does not exist yet; ZFW-288/ZFW-331 shipped without it
impact.py shown without methodology/confidence on primary dashboard surfaces; business.py is the in-repo positive exemplar
build_context() concatenates full note history verbatim with no redaction/minimization (T-AI-002, T-RAI-029)
forecast.json buy-rate assumptions applied uniformly across all five stores with no per-store/representativeness validation ahead of 400-store scale (T-RAI-030)
